parameters.query:
select lead_hash, email_normalized, first_name, mautic_contact_id, completed_rank,
       cta_type, form_submitted_at, video1_completed_at, video2_completed_at,
       video3_completed_at, last_seen_at, berater_slug, profile_code,
       main_aspiration, initial_barrier, lang
from leads.v_lead_state_full
where source_app = 'business_leads_quiz'
  and funnel_key = 'business'
  and email_normalized is not null
  and first_name is not null
order by first_seen_at desc, lead_hash asc

parameters.url: ={{ 'https://mautic.hl-support.biz/api/emails/' + $('Code - Select Email ID').item.json.emailId + '/contact/' + $('Code - Select Email ID').item.json.mauticContactId + '/send' }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ replyToAddress: $('Code - Select Email ID').item.json.coachEmail, fromAddress: 'mail@mail.hl-support.biz', fromName: $('Code - Select Email ID').item.json.coachDisplayName || 'Activecenter' }) }}

parameters.query:
select lead_hash, event_name, event_at, payload
from leads.lead_events
where event_name in ('test_lead_marked','test_lead_unmarked','nurture_sent')
order by event_at desc, event_uid asc

select id, session_hash, lead_hash, form_email, funnel, updated_at
from leads.tracking_sessions
where lead_hash = $1
order by updated_at desc
limit 1

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ action: 'generate_resume_token', payload: { sessionHash: $('Code - Build Resume Request').item.json.sessionHash, leadHash: $('Code - Build Resume Request').item.json.lead_hash, email: $('Code - Build Resume Request').item.json.email, resumeTarget: $('Code - Build Resume Request').item.json.resumeTargetRequest || 'videos', slug: $('Code - Build Resume Request').item.json.berater_slug || '', context: 'business' } }) }}

parameters.jsCode:
const eventItems = $input.all();
return [{ json: { ready: true, event_count: eventItems.length } }];
